title: 第19章 谁在称无敌哪个在言不败第20章 秒杀唐七
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
“呼！”
一阵狂风刮过，直指慕容雅。
竟是那莫流苏按耐不住，直接出手了。
她急了，她急了！
慕容雅脸上笑意更甚，雪发飞扬，探掌而出。
“我知道你很急，但是你先别急！”
电光火石间，两人对了一招，莫流苏来得快去得更快，整个人被怼飞了出去，砸在了高台上。
九重高台，倾刻坍塌。
恐怖的气机流转弥漫，烟尘飞扬，台上的八十一个弟子像是被锁住了，一时间竟然无法逃脱。
“快救人！”
白鹤长老惊呼道，眼看着那些弟子就要被埋葬在尘土之下。
正当此时，周通出手了。
“合！”
只见他一拍手，八十一道子阵融入到了主阵中，瞬间斩断了气息封锁。
这片刻的功夫带来了生机，那些弟子同时发力，挣脱而出，无一伤亡。
“多谢师兄救命之恩！”
他们单膝跪下，朝着周通虔诚的跪拜。
“不必了，我已不是你们的师兄。”
周通说的绝情，让这些弟子的眼中多了一缕黯然之色，但紧接着，他们眼中只剩下真挚的感激。
众人皆惊，刚才周通出手的速度太快了，而且手段过于高深，让他们都摸不着头脑。

更关键的是，他们竟然无法看出周通的实力，像是没有修为，又像是分魂境巅峰，总之扑朔迷离。
只有一点可以确定，周通身上根本没有道伤，他强势依旧！
这让其他宗门的天才们都颤抖了，难道这次百宗大会他们还要被此人再度压制吗？
“没出息的东西，是他的师尊让你们陷入了危机，你们又何须拜他？”
只听轰的一声，尘土炸开，一道狼狈的倩影缓缓显现。
莫流苏钗环凌乱，嘴角挂着一缕鲜血，气息也变得短促了许多。
人们再一次见证了慕容雅的强悍，这女人尽管背负着道伤和心魔，也不是同辈人可以碰瓷的。
“你以为你赢定了吗？”
莫流苏深深的吸了一口气，不服气得说道。
“你可以继续，我只用一只手就够了。”
慕容雅蔑视道，让莫流苏胸膛起伏，几欲再战！
“且慢！”
就在这时，唐七突然插在了两人的中间。
“小七你让开，这里危险。”
“师尊不必担忧，我自有解决的办法。”
唐七人畜无害的笑道，转头看向慕容雅，神色又变得严肃了起来。
“慕容前辈，今日是我的拜师典礼，你却强闯我宗门，伤我师尊，哪怕你是强者，我也要讨个公道。”
话音落下，他转动天道剑，对准了慕容雅。
“我要向你…的弟子发起剑道挑战，若我赢了，你就要向我的师尊道歉。”
“嗤…”

慕容雅冷笑：“月儿，教他做人！”
“遵命！”
小妖女跃跃欲试，一步踏出，近乎超凡的气息让唐七脸色一变。
content_en:
"Phew!"
A strong wind blew past, pointing directly at Murong Ya.
Mo Liusu couldn't hold it any longer and took action directly.
She is anxious, she is anxious!
The smile on Murong Ya's face became even bigger, her snowy hair flew up, and she stretched out her palms.
"I know you are in a hurry, but don't be in a hurry yet!"
In the flash of lightning, the two exchanged moves. Mo Liusu came and went faster, and his whole body was sent flying out and hit the high platform.
The nine-layer high platform collapsed.
Terrifying Qi flow filled the air, and smoke and dust flew into the sky. The eighty-one disciples on the stage seemed to be locked, and for a while they were unable to escape.
"Hurry and save people!"
Elder Bai He exclaimed, seeing those disciples about to be buried under the dust.
At this moment, Zhou Tong took action.
"Come together!"
He clapped his hands, and eighty-one sub-formations merged into the main formation, instantly cutting off the aura blockade.
This moment of effort brought vitality. The disciples exerted their strength at the same time and broke free without any casualties.
"Thank you, senior brother, for saving your life!"
They knelt down on one knee and worshiped Zhou Tong devoutly.
"No need, I am no longer your senior brother."
Zhou Tong's unfeeling words gave these disciples a gleam of sadness, but then, there was only sincere gratitude in their eyes.
Everyone was shocked. Zhou Tong's attack just now was too fast, and his method was too sophisticated, which made them all confused.
What's more important is that they can't see Zhou Tong's strength. It seems that he has no cultivation level, and he seems to be at the peak of the Soul Split Realm. In short, it is confusing.
There is only one thing that is certain, Zhou Tong has no Dao injuries at all, he is still as strong as ever!
This made the geniuses of other sects tremble. Will they be suppressed by this person again in this Hundred Sects Conference?
"You're worthless, it's his master who put you in crisis, why do you need to worship him?"
There was a bang, the dust exploded, and a wolfish figure slowly appeared.
Mo Liusu's hairpin was messy, a wisp of blood hung from the corner of his mouth, and his breath became much shorter.
People once again witnessed Murong Ya's strength. Even though this woman was burdened with wounds and inner demons, she was not something that her peers could touch.
"Do you think you will win?"
Mo Liusu took a deep breath and said angrily.
"You can continue, I'll do it with just one hand."
Murong Ya said contemptuously, making Mo Liusu's chest rise and fall, wanting to fight again!
"Wait!"
At this moment, Tang Qi suddenly stepped in between the two of them.
"Xiao Qi, get out of the way, it's dangerous here."
"Master, don't worry, I have my own solution."
Tang Qi smiled harmlessly, turned to look at Murong Ya, and his expression became serious again.
"Senior Murong, today is my apprenticeship ceremony, but you forced your way into my sect and hurt my master. Even if you are a strong man, I still want justice."
After he finished speaking, he turned the Tiandao Sword and pointed it at Murong Ya.
"I'm going to challenge your...disciple in swordsmanship. If I win, you have to apologize to my master."
"Tsk..."
Murong Ya sneered: "Yue'er, teach him how to behave!"
"As you command!"
The little demon girl was eager to try, and took one step forward. The almost extraordinary aura made Tang Qi's expression change.
